meta.title: NORVARDEN — Another Way Forward
meta.description: An accessible, verified career platform for people with disabilities. Jobs from inclusive, verified employers. Free for job seekers. You decide what you share.

hero.headline: Talent has
hero.subheadline: NORVARDEN connects people with disabilities to verified, inclusive employers. Free for job seekers, accessible from the ground up, and private by design: you decide what you share, and no one gets your contact details until you say yes.

stories.heading: Your skills lead.
stories.body: Your profile puts your experience, skills and goals first.

stories.heading: Every employer is checked.
stories.body: We confirm each company’s identity and hiring contact, and every employer signs our accessible-hiring pledge
stories.highlight: before they can post a job.

stories.heading: Accommodations, up front.
stories.body: Jobs show the accommodations on offer — remote work, flexible hours, assistive technology, accessible interviews —
stories.highlight: so you don’t have to ask first.

stories.heading: You decide who reaches you.
stories.body: Companies send a request. Your contact details are shared

stories.heading: Built to be used by everyone.
stories.body: Screen readers, keyboard-only, voice control, zoom and high contrast all work.
stories.highlight: Accessibility isn’t a feature here. It’s the foundation.

stories.heading: Never pay to apply.
stories.body: Job seekers never pay for anything.
stories.highlight: If anyone asks you for money, report it.

stories.heading: Another way forward.
stories.body: A career platform designed with the disability community, not just for it.
stories.highlight: Join free and see who’s hiring.

trustStrip.label: Accessible by design
trustStrip.body: Built to WCAG 2.2 AA: works with screen readers, keyboard, voice control and zoom.

trustStrip.label: Verified employers
trustStrip.body: Every company is identity-checked and signs our accessible-hiring pledge.

trustStrip.label: Private by default
trustStrip.body: Disability and accommodation details are optional and never shown without your OK.

trustStrip.label: Free for job seekers
trustStrip.body: No fees, ever. Employers pay to post jobs and connect.

steps.title: Create your free profile
steps.body: Share your skills, experience and the work you want. Add accommodation needs only if you choose to.

steps.title: Find inclusive employers
steps.body: Browse jobs that list their accommodations up front, from companies that have signed our pledge.

steps.title: Connect on your terms
steps.body: Companies request to connect. You accept or decline, and your contact details stay private until you say yes.

cards.label: Job seekers
cards.title: People with disabilities
cards.body: Visible or invisible, physical, sensory, cognitive, mental health or chronic illness. Self-identify only — no proof, ever.

cards.label: Students & early career
cards.title: Your first role
cards.body: Internships and entry-level roles from employers who budget for accommodations and mentorship.

cards.label: Career changers
cards.title: Your next chapter
cards.body: Changing fields after an injury, diagnosis or life change? Find employers who value the skills you already have.

athletesBand.headline: Work that
athletesBand.body: Filter by remote, flexible hours, assistive technology and accessible interviews. Apply to employers who have already said yes to accommodations.

coachesBand.headline: Start
coachesBand.body: Internships, apprenticeships and first jobs, plus help writing your résumé and preparing for interviews — including how and when to talk about accommodations.

veteransBand.headline: Your next
veteransBand.body: Employers committed to hiring veterans with disabilities, help translating your experience, and resources for your next step.

forCompaniesBand.headline: Hiring? Reach a talent pool most companies overlook.

items.question: Is NORVARDEN free?
items.answer: Yes. It’s always free for job seekers. Verified employers pay to post jobs and connect with candidates.

items.question: Do I have to disclose my disability?
items.answer: No. You never have to prove or disclose a disability. Any disability or accommodation details are optional, private by default, and only shared with a company if you choose.

items.question: How are employers verified?
items.answer: We confirm each company’s identity, business and hiring contact, and every employer signs our accessible-hiring pledge before posting jobs.

items.question: Is the site accessible?
items.answer: NORVARDEN is built to WCAG 2.2 AA and tested with screen readers and keyboard-only use. If anything gets in your way, tell us and we’ll fix it.

items.question: Who sees my contact details?
items.answer: No one, until you accept a company’s connection request.
